APPROVE final substantive target SHA-256 fef499a6217de76d8bbbee3f60aee82bfcd067d2259de762336d74e03703e6f2, 292 lines, whitespace check clean.

The three role corrections are necessary and internally consistent with the nonempty-set and non-inheritance contract. TransNetV2 may emit numeric scores and derived boundary proposals, so Measurement + Proposal preserves their different authority. ByteTrack association proposes track structure from typed detections and is not itself an observation, so Proposal is the sound role. The combined face-encoder and SAM-family registry row can contain vector Measurements and detection or track Proposals while explicitly preventing either from establishing character or action identity. Every affected row remains Deferred or CandidateOnly, HoldUnknown, operationally unresolved, unrealized, and outside the nominated leaf records.

No semantic regression appears elsewhere relative to the approved 9abc51b content: exact ContentDetector nomination, proposal-versus-acceptance boundary, evidence pins, cache/CI, notice, rights, retention, native-closure, and court authorization holds remain intact. I find no remaining substantive blocker. This approval does not authorize artifacts, source media, dependencies, execution, B0/P1/C1 closure, or accepted scientific claims. I will rescan the promised review-record-only final artifact hash.
